canonical_project: SK Group / AWS Ulsan AI Data Center
owner: SK Group / SK Telecom / SK Broadband / Amazon Web Services
notes: Asia Business Daily reported SK Group and AWS are constructing a 103 MW AI-dedicated data center on a 36,000 sq m site in Hwangseong-dong, Nam-gu, Ulsan, within Ulsan Mipo National Industrial Complex. Schedule reported: launch ceremony June 2025, groundbreaking August 2025, 40 MW first phase operational by November 2027, full 103 MW by February 2029.
